input_contract: Production daemon must validate external --stim-bin packets through avid_validate_packet rather than overwriting flags/seq_id

expected.daemon_ingress_validation: Reject truncated 3B --stim-bin (rc=2) and preserve/validate raw packet flags & seq_id

actual.daemon_ingress_validation: truncated_3B --stim-bin rejected with rc=2; raw --stim-bin flags validated end-to-end (validator_invalid_flags=64, validator_valid_packets=0)
